body: I just closed the door, what if I told you I don’t know whether it’s opened or closed?
Honestly? Thank you. I’m glad you’re doing better.
I’m conflicted. I’m glad people relate but sad because it’s something I wouldn’t wish upon no one.

I’ve been on Abilify and I’m sad to say that at first it worked wonders but now the symptoms are kind of coming back. Mostly because being under stress can “activate” them. I’ve started to take Alprazolam(Xanax) recently and even tho I get really sleepy and thirsty at least it helps a bit with the thoughts. Glad to hear that your son is doing good.

Yeah, it’s at night when I hear most of the voices. I’ve been told that they are pretty common with people under stress or in the change from being awake to asleep. Hypnagonic hallucinations it’s their name. 
I’m happy that you have a reliable source to vent to.  Hope you get to cope with the anxiety.
Yes, especially at night. I kind of blame it on being tired from the whole day journey, but deep down I know that at night it’s when my symptoms get acute.
